title: On Claude Code, observe records no tool outcomes
trigger: Before relying on host observations (Stop capture reminder, evidence IDs) on Claude Code, or when the Stop reminder seems never to fire
behavior_delta: Do not assume Claude Code tool results become observations: check memory_observations for non-user_correction rows first. Until observe handles Claude Code's shapes, the Stop capture reminder fires there only after a detected user correction.
what: Do not assume Claude Code tool results become observations: check memory_observations for non-user_correction rows first. Until observe handles Claude Code's shapes, the Stop capture reminder fires there only after a detected user correction.
why: observationFromTool needs a numeric exit code or is_error; Claude Code's Bash response has neither on success, and failed calls likely go to PostToolUseFailure, which hooks/hooks.json does not register. A full day of passing and failing test runs left 0 tool observations and 3 user corrections, so the capture reminder looked broken.

assumptions.description: Claude Code routes failed tool calls to PostToolUseFailure rather than PostToolUse; not yet confirmed with a logging hook

revisit_when.description: observe learns Claude Code's result shapes

evidence_refs.summary: observationFromTool returns null unless exit code or is_error marks a failure or a validation
Registers PostToolUse only; no failure event
The only observation offered at Stop this session was a user correction
